name: The Fold
summary: The Fold is a minor Horde military encampment nestled near Talondeep Pass in the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as a vital staging post and early rest stop for Horde soldiers marching into the craggy peaks from Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Foothold Beyond the Pass
sections.body: Tucked away near the mountain pass connecting Stonetalon to Ashenvale, The Fold functions as the Horde's front door to these rugged heights. Troops moving southward through Talondeep Pass rely on this small fortified camp to catch their breath, resupply, and coordinate reconnaissance before venturing deeper into the contested terrain of the mountains.

faq.answer: The Fold is a small Horde forward camp situated in the northern reaches of Stonetalon Mountains, sitting right near the exit of Talondeep Pass.

faq.q: Why is this camp important to the Horde?
faq.answer: It serves as the initial staging point and safe haven for Horde travelers and forces entering Stonetalon Mountains from the forested territory of Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is The Fold safe for Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: No. The Fold is an active Horde military position, and any Alliance travelers attempting to pass through will be attacked on sight by the stationed guards.

angles.text: For Horde warriors advancing out of the dense canopy of Ashenvale, The Fold provides an essential first haven to rearm before pressing into the crags of Stonetalon.
Alliance scouts charting paths across Talondeep Pass must steer clear of The Fold to avoid provoking Horde sentries stationed at the mountain threshold.
